entry_point_reason: VERIFIED by reading scripts/csd-train-all.py: run_region() (the code path --regions memory takes) calls cogsyndelta.regions.pretrain.pretrain_region() directly and never imports or calls cogsyndelta.regions.memory.run_memory_pretrain or cogsyndelta.eval.beir_fiqa. That means a csd-train-all.py --regions memory run -- the pattern the persistent csd-train@.service template uses -- would train the region but never compute the BEIR full-pool eval, the BM25 reference, or the five pre-registered W4 gates. regions/memory.py's own CLI is the only code path that runs pretrain_region() AND THEN the BEIR eval AND THEN cogsyndelta.eval.beir_fiqa.w4_gates(), all inside one process/run. Launched via that CLI instead of csd-train-all.py so this run actually produces the row's pre-registered gates.

config.lr_derivation: lr_for_batch(512) = BASE_LR(3e-4) * sqrt(512/256), scripts/csd-train-all.py, same formula the parent compress/retrieve production runs used at their own batch
config.init_embedding_from_note: DEC-24's shared-embedding-table inheritance from retrieve was NOT applied -- naming the design intent without a path trains from a random init, matching scripts/csd-train-all.py's own default behaviour. A retrieve final.pt checkpoint exists at /akula-data/csd/receipts/retrieve-checkpoints/final.pt if a later run wants to apply it via --retrieve-checkpoint.
config.batch_deviation: PRE-REGISTERED/production batch for text regions is 1280 (DEFAULT_BATCH in scripts/csd-train-all.py; matches the actual compress/retrieve/code production receipts from 2026-09-03, all steps=4000 batch=1280). memory.py's own EVIDENCE (MEASURED_VRAM_AT_BATCH_512, memory.py:88-112) measured peak_whole_card_mib=13079 at batch=512 with these exact token-aware terms on. Extrapolating that measurement linearly to batch=1280 (2.5x) predicts >32,000 MiB, which does not fit a 23,028 MiB card (this is also why the 'reason' region OOMed at batch 1280/max_len 256 on 2026-09-03, per program/csd-w4-control-arm-result and the fleet's own OOM receipt). Batch 512 was used instead, at the exact config MEASURED_VRAM_AT_BATCH_512/EVIDENCE_50_STEP_CONTROL_ARM already measured; lr re-derived for batch 512 via the same lr_for_batch formula rather than left at the 1280 value.

shard_limit_note: regions/memory.py resolves ALL shards via glob (no shard_limit concept) -- equivalent to csd-train-all.py's --shard-limit 0, not its default of 2.

corpus_inputs_verified.bm25_reference: computed live in-process by cogsyndelta.eval.beir_fiqa.BM25 (an in-repo implementation, no external rank_bm25 dependency needed -- verified rank_bm25 is NOT installed in the venv and is not imported)
